name: leucine zipper like post translational regulator 1
pathways: negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction

function.text: LZTR1 encodes leucine-zipper-like transcriptional regulator 1. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity and small GTPase binding. It participates in negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction and protein ubiquitination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to LZTR1-related schwannomatosis (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Endometrial Carcinoma; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Hepatocellular Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
